## Selected Publications

You can either type publications manually or use BibTeX citations.

### 2026

- **Your Name**, Coauthor A, Coauthor B. *Paper Title*. Journal Name, 2026.
- **Your Name**, Coauthor C. *Another Paper Title*. Conference Name, 2026.

## BibTeX Example

The project includes `references.bib`. You can cite an entry in any page using:

```markdown
[@sample2026]
```
